newsitem.title: GERMANY: German AMB says sees higher 1997 profits.
newsitem.headline: German AMB says sees higher 1997 profits.

text.p: German insurer Aachener und Muenchener Beteiligungs AG (AMB) said on Monday it expected group profits in 1997 to be at least as high as in 1996, when net earnings rose some 31 percent to 343.4 million marks.
"The AMB group expects satisfactory growth for 1997," the insurer said in a statement.
As long as claims did not worsen sharply and capital markets were stable, the group said "we can expect a group result at least at the previous year's level".
The company released precise profit figure for 1996 on Monday after having said in February that profits were about 340 million marks.
